 Josh Hokit copies Conor McGregor, steals UFC belts from Amanda Nunes at UFC 334 media day
 Connie did it better .
 by Jesse Holland Nov 11, 2026, 6:50 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Part Of UFC 334 streaming results: Live Gane vs. Hokit-led updates, video highlights see all updates Jesse Holland is among the longest-tenured media professionals in the combat sports news space, covering MMA, professional wrestling and boxing on a full-time basis since early 2004. Josh Hokit will not be able to call himself UFC champion until he defeats Ciryl Gane in the UFC 334 main event this weekend on Paramount+ at Madison Square Garden in New York City. But that doesn’t mean “The Incredible Hok” can’t parade around the “Big Apple” with a couple of belts.
 Related
 UFC 334 odds: Betting lines open for Ciryl Gane vs. Josh Hokit, Amanda Nunes vs. Kayla Harrison title fights 
 Hokit walked up to the media day table prepared for former two-division champion and UFC 334 co-headliner Amanda Nunes and casually walked off with her titles. Fortunately for the unsuspecting “Lioness,” the PR team was able to track Hokit down and return the belts to their rightful owner.
 Have a look:
 Nunes returns to challenge reigning UFC bantamweight champion Kayla Harrison .
 “I’m going to pressure him, and he only has a few options after that, whether he overextends or he cowers away and tries to run — he cannot run forever,” Hokit told Uncrowned . “He’s going to try to pitter-patter, point [fight]. He won’t be able to stay away from me forever, and if he tries, he will be tired from just that. I’ll get my hands on him one way or the other and then f***ing wear him out. Make him look like any other sloppy heavyweight.”
